name: Decrepit Bridge
description: The 30-foot-long, 10-foot-wide bridge groans under the weight of those who cross it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Perilous Sway
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A Medium or larger creature Strides 10 feet or more in the bridge's area

Effect All creatures on the bridge must attempt a DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Clumsy 1 until the beginning of its next turn.

Failure The creature falls Prone.

Critical Failure The creature falls from the bridge, landing in the ravine 20 feet below.

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description: Each time the decrepit bridge triggers its Perilous Sway after the first, attempt a DC 5 Flat . On a failure, the bridge collapses. All creatures on the bridge fall 20 feet into the ravine, taking falling damage normally (10 Bludgeoning Damage damage).
